_note: Per-colour tank state. Rank is the game's own WORD, not an index -- the index is derivable through RANK_NAMES, the reverse is not. Rows appear two ways: the 2026-08-28 census entered each colour once and read rank off the wire; every session since records its own colour automatically at teardown, adding kills, deaths, promo and leaderboard position. A SNAPSHOT, not a live truth: rank moves with play (a kill promotes, a deactivation demotes one rank), so re-measure rather than trust an old row. Rank drives both `fuel_capacity` (1000 + 100*rank) and `radar_radius` (2 + rank//3), so the highest-ranked colour is the strongest tank an account can field.
